_note: Manual sets (artist- or Jules-provided). Applied by lineup.js on every grid tick and after every refresh; never overwritten by scrapers. Date = the night (CT), times 24h CT; a set ending after midnight still belongs to its start night (midnight end is 00:00). A non-empty stage is another floor (Rooftop, 2nd Floor, 3rd Floor, and so on): when that slot already has a main-floor set (no stage), the staged set is added beside it and does not replace TBA rows. Any number of stage names can share a night. A stage on an otherwise open slot still fills the grid. If a scraped set with the same bar/band/start exists, the scraped row is kept and only its end time is corrected. Closures ({bar,date,closed_from,closed_to}, night-relative 24h CT, start in [from,to)) remove empty TBA grid rows in that range; rated and owner rows are never touched.
